SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-07-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HENTON, FRANK M. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA HASTINGS COLLEGE OF THE LAW LIBRARY SHELTON, OFFICER ED (BADGE NO. G-45) ALTHOUGH UC HASTING DENIED PLAINTIFF ACCESS TO ITS LAW LIBRARY, I FIND NO EVIDENCE OTHER THAN PLAINTIFF'S SURMISE THAT THIS WRONGFUL DENIAL WAS THE BASIS OF ETHNICITY, RACE, OR NATIONAL ORIGIN. ON PLAINTIFFS ASSAULT CLAIM, THE PARTIES DISPUTE WHETHER SHELTON'S GETTING UP FROM HIS DESK WAS DONE IN A THREATENING MANNER THAT WOULD CAUSE IMMEDIATE FEAR IN A REASONABLE PERSON. BECAUSE PLAINTIFF BEARS THE BURDEN OF PROOF, I FIND IN FAVOR OF DEFENDANTS ON THIS CLAIM. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
